newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - YIT JAN-APRIL PROFIT SEEN HIGHER.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - YIT JAN-APRIL PROFIT SEEN HIGHER.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts
covering Finnish equities showed a 40 million markka median
forecast for Finnish construction group YIT-Yhtyma Oy's
January-April profit before extraordinary items and tax.
Profit before extras, tax EPS
(FIM million) (FIM)
Median 40 1.2
Mean 42 1.3
Lowest 30 0.7
Highest 57 2.3
(Profit forecasts by eight analysts, EPS forecasts by seven)
YIT's four-month results are due on June 9 at around
In January-April 1996, YIT-Yhtyma posted a profit of 23
million markka.
In February, YIT-Yhtyma said it expected earnings for the
current year to exceed last year's.
The median of seven analysts' forecasts for YIT's full-year
1997 profit before extras and tax was 231.1 million markka (mean
231 million) in a 197-265 million markka range.
In 1996, YIT's profit was 169 million markka.
Contributors to the survey were AG Private Bankers, Aros
Securities, Carnegie Securities, Erik Selin, Evli Securities,
FIM Securities, Handelsbanken, Merita Securities and
Postipankki.
